Name: Initial inventory
Description: Cases on hand at every stage at the start (classic game: 12).

Name: Initial demand
Description: Weekly demand the chain starts in equilibrium with.

Name: Base demand
Description: Customer demand before the step (regime 0).

Name: Step demand
Description: Customer demand after the step (regime 0).

Name: Step week
Description: Week of the step in demand (regime 0).

Name: Demand regime
Description: 0 step, 1 i.i.d. normal, 2 data series.

Name: Demand mean
Description: Mean of the i.i.d. regime and of the base-stock formula.

Name: Demand sd
Description: Standard deviation of the i.i.d. regime and of the base-stock formula.

Name: Demand seed
Description: Seed of the i.i.d. regime.

Name: Service z
Description: Safety factor of the base-stock formula (about 90% service).

Name: Holding cost
Description: Per case on hand per week (classic game: 0.5; backlog is twice that).

Name: Backlog cost
Description: Per case in backlog per week.

Name: Test start
Description: Costs and statistics are counted from this week on.

Name: Use equilibrium S prime
Description: 1: desired stock is the equilibrium-consistent one (tests T2, T3); 0: the S prime constants below.

Name: Fixed order weeks
Description: Orders are held at the initial demand for weeks 1 to this one (board game: 4).

Name: Round orders
Description: 1: orders are whole cases, rounded half up (board game); 0: continuous.

Name: Retailer policy
Description: 0 anchoring and adjustment (P0, P2), 1 base-stock (P1).

Name: Retailer theta
Description: Smoothing of expected demand (PLACEHOLDER).

Name: Retailer alpha
Description: Fraction of the stock gap closed per week (PLACEHOLDER).

Name: Retailer beta
Description: Weight on the supply line; below 1 means it is underweighted (PLACEHOLDER).

Name: Retailer S prime
Description: Desired stock when not using the equilibrium value (PLACEHOLDER).

Name: Retailer base stock level
Description: Order-up-to level of the base-stock policy; the starting value is the formula mean*(L+1) + z*sd*sqrt(L+1).
